Consider the following transition diagram in which a thread moves between each of the 33 states :


Below we give some conditions that cause the thread to move between each of the 33 states, and causes each arrow :

  • P:P: Process is scheduled and run by the scheduler
  • Q:Q: Time slice runs out, but the process is still wanting to run.
  • R:R: I/O completes, or lock is acquired. Woken up by a semaphore or conditional.
  • S:S: Any blocking action. I/O request, lock blocks.
